title: Bead-Based ELISA for SARS-CoV-2 Spike RBD Detection
author: Boren Lin
materials: ACROBiosystems SARS-CoV-2 Spike RBD-coupled Magnetic Beads
Mouse Monoclonal Anti-Human IgG Fc (HRP) (Abcam, Cat. #: ab99759, Cambridge, UK)
with Aluminum Adaptor for 96-well Deep Well Plate

steps.title: Place sample plate on magnet
steps.instruction: Place the pre‑loaded 96‑well plate containing 100 µL of each serum sample onto the Magnetic Module and engage the magnet.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of the SARS‑CoV‑2 Spike RBD‑coupled magnetic bead suspension into each well of the plate.

steps.title: Incubate bead‑sample mixture
steps.instruction: Move the plate to the Heater Shaker Module and incubate for 60 min at 1000 rpm.

steps.title: First wash series
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet, discard the supernatant, then perform three washes: add 250 µL wash buffer to each well, mix, re‑engage the magnet and discard the supernatant each time.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL wash buffer and mix

steps.title: Add HRP‑anti‑IgG
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Mouse Monoclonal Anti‑Human IgG Fc (HRP) solution to each well.

steps.title: Incubate secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Move the plate to the Heater Shaker Module and incubate for 60 min at 1000 rpm.

steps.title: Second wash series
steps.instruction: Engage the magnet, discard the supernatant, then perform three washes: add 250 µL wash buffer to each well, mix, re‑engage the magnet and discard the supernatant each time.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL wash buffer and mix

steps.title: Develop with TMB
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of TMB substrate solution to each well, move the plate to the Heater Shaker Module, and incubate for 5 min at 1000 rpm.

steps.title: Stop reaction and transfer
steps.instruction: Move the plate to the Magnetic Module, add 50 µL of Stop Solution to each well, then transfer 100 µL of the resulting supernatant to a fresh 96‑well plate while the magnet remains engaged.

steps.title: Read absorbance
steps.instruction: Place the final plate in a microplate reader and measure absorbance at 450 nm.
